reviews.comment: If you have the opportunity to take a class from him, do it! He is the best professor I've had at Texas A&M so far. His exam style is unique, it allows you to speak your mind about the topics in class and give good context behind your answers. He cares about his students so much and you will actually gain great knowledge on historical events.
Just an all round standup guy, love his stuff

Dr. Conrad is amazing. He is so intelligent and shares so much wisdom. I enjoyed all of his lectures, and the class is straightforward if you stay on top of your work. Most of the time it didn't even feel like I was in class, because I was just so interested to learn.

Dr. Conrad is a wonderful teacher and man. He puts his own spin on the content so there's no rigid plan for the year. He gives 3 opportunities for grades with a lot of flexibility. He really cares about the students. Class is optional, but he loves when people come and participate. I have no doubt taking a class with him will be worth it.

Dr. Conrad is by far my favorite prof I've taken at A&M. I've taken him for 2 honors upper level COMM classes and he is the sweetest and most caring professor who genuinely cares about his students' learning and success! He teaches material that is useful outside of class and allows his students to even pick topics that interest them! 100% take him

Dr. Conrad has been my favorite professor at TAMU. He cares so much about his students and met me outside of his office hours to talk about "real world" jobs. I would highly recommend him to anyone! Go to class and participate and he will like you, too.

Dr. Conrad is one of the rare professors who genuinely cares about his students, not only their academics, but also their personal thoughts, opinions, and well being. He went out of his way to cast polls to see which topics our class preferred then catered our class to those topics. Dr. Conrad is also very intelligent and has infinite knowledge.

CONRAD IS THE BEST PROFESSOR I HAVE EVER HAD! He is so wise, and has a passion for teaching. He truly cares about students and gives out articles/ random information for the sole purpose of learning to learn, not to memorize or be tested over it. He sees his students as people, and makes his best effort to learn from them just as we learn from him.

You can learn a lot in this class from other people's speeches and everything Dr. Conrad inevitably knows about their topics (sometimes he knows a little too much and everyone zones out). You get free reign on speech topics and will get good feedback from him and your classmates. He even gives out "life articles" to teach you about the real world.

He is very knowledgeable about a lot of things so you could have a long conversation with him about anything. He cares about his students and tries to get to know everybody. If you show interest in a certain topic he'll send you articles about that topic. He only uses email and not ecampus which is strange but he gives you back grades quickly

Dr. Conrad is a wonderful professor! He truly cares about all of his students and if you get the chance to get to know him, he will make sure to help you with anything you need! I have taken 3 classes with him already and wish I could take more. His tests arent easy, but his classes/life lessons that he teaches in class are worth it!

I took Communication 203 Honors with him and the class was amazing! He taught me so much about life and speech! The class consisted of three speeches and three written reports! Overall, wonderful class with a wonderful prof!

Dr. Conrad was the best professor I've ever had b/c he genuinely cares. Get to know him!!!!!! he tries to help you out as much as possible. Going to class is important because there are questions from lecture on the test, reading the book is important too but it's not too bad. Tests have a&B, all of above, etc but not too bad if you just study
Look, he's a good prof and really helpful. If you do the work and pay attention, you'll be fine. If you skimp out, then best of luck.
He is a great teacher, the lectures get a bit boring at time but he is so helpful! His test are kinda difficult.

His test are so hard!!! Made a study guide with all lecture notes and notes over chapters and still struggled on his tests. All of his test have A, B, C then A&B, or None  or All of the above of A&C.  Avoid
